_notes: Crystalline Underdark boss / named-rare loot (2026-10-27). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make). All 18 weapon types appear exactly once across this file; armour is ten pieces apiece across cloth/leather/mail/plate. Checked by tools/qa_underdark_content.py.

Hoarfang.name: Glacier-Jaw Pike
Hoarfang.flavor_text: Ice in the sockets, and the sockets are not his.

Hoarfang.name: Hoarfang's Matted Pelt
Hoarfang.flavor_text: Four inches thick, and frozen through all four.

Hoarfang.name: Upper Dark Stalker's Treads
Hoarfang.flavor_text: He came down here because something colder came down first.

Hoarfang.name: Fang-Chipped Torc
Hoarfang.flavor_text: Bone, with one tooth missing and nothing to show where it went.

The Frozen Cartographer.name: Surveyor's Scribing Knife
The Frozen Cartographer.flavor_text: For ruling lines, which is all it has ever been used for.

The Frozen Cartographer.name: Expedition Cartographer's Coat
The Frozen Cartographer.flavor_text: Pockets still full of chalk. The chalk is still dry.

The Frozen Cartographer.name: Frostbitten Dividers
The Frozen Cartographer.flavor_text: Set to a width nobody down here can account for.

The Frozen Cartographer.name: Unfinished Survey Bracers
The Frozen Cartographer.flavor_text: The last entry reads: the readings are wrong and I am going on.

Latticeborn.name: Repeating Lattice Maul
Latticeborn.flavor_text: Swung once. The second swing arrives on its own.

Latticeborn.name: Latticeborn Carapace
Latticeborn.flavor_text: Grown in exact rows, which nothing alive bothers to do.

Latticeborn.name: Pattern-Cut Greaves
Latticeborn.flavor_text: The facets repeat every eleven inches, without exception.

Latticeborn.name: First Iteration Band
Latticeborn.flavor_text: One of a great many, and all of them identical.

Capgorger.name: Gorger's Rending Claw
Capgorger.flavor_text: It eats the groves it lives in, which is a poor long-term plan.

Capgorger.name: Cap-Gorged Hide Vest
Capgorger.flavor_text: Distended, and still faintly warm in the middle.

Capgorger.name: Sporefall Canopy Hood
Capgorger.flavor_text: Cut from a cap big enough to shelter under.

Capgorger.name: Spore-Light Pendant
Capgorger.flavor_text: Glows a little in the dark, which down here is no distinction.

The Thousandth Shard.name: Wand of the Counted Facet
The Thousandth Shard.flavor_text: The Codex counted to nine hundred and ninety-nine and stopped.

The Thousandth Shard.name: Thousandfold Shardmail
The Thousandth Shard.flavor_text: Every scale the same size. Every single one.

The Thousandth Shard.name: Enumerator's Gauntlets
The Thousandth Shard.flavor_text: For handling things that object to being handled.

The Thousandth Shard.name: Shard-Count Signet
The Thousandth Shard.flavor_text: Engraved with a number that is one short.

Marsh-Mother Ysmil.name: Marsh-Mother's Lumen Stave
Marsh-Mother Ysmil.flavor_text: Lit from the inside, the way everything in her water is.

Marsh-Mother Ysmil.name: Brood-Tender's Scale Kilt
Marsh-Mother Ysmil.flavor_text: She mothered something. It was not her own.

Marsh-Mother Ysmil.name: Drowned-Light Slippers
Marsh-Mother Ysmil.flavor_text: Never dry, and never quite wet.

Marsh-Mother Ysmil.name: Ysmil's Clutch-Brooch
Marsh-Mother Ysmil.flavor_text: Warm. Pulses, on a cycle, roughly with the Lumen.

Archivist Thelun, Unlisted.name: Thelun's Unlisted Tome
Archivist Thelun, Unlisted.flavor_text: The Codex burned their copy. He was not using their copy.

Archivist Thelun, Unlisted.name: Robes of the Struck Entry
Archivist Thelun, Unlisted.flavor_text: The Codex sigil unpicked from the breast, badly, in a hurry.

Archivist Thelun, Unlisted.name: Marginalia Shoulderpads
Archivist Thelun, Unlisted.flavor_text: Covered edge to edge in a hand getting smaller and faster.

Archivist Thelun, Unlisted.name: Expunged Archivist's Band
Archivist Thelun, Unlisted.flavor_text: His name was filed off it. The groove is still legible.

What Walks in the Dim.name: Unlit Cleaver
What Walks in the Dim.flavor_text: Nobody has described this. Several people have tried.

What Walks in the Dim.name: Dim-Walker's Lightless Mantle
What Walks in the Dim.flavor_text: The Lumen does not land on it. It simply does not.

What Walks in the Dim.name: Hide of the Unseen Thing
What Walks in the Dim.flavor_text: Taken off something that was never properly looked at.

What Walks in the Dim.name: Charm Against the Dark
What Walks in the Dim.flavor_text: Codex issue. Not Codex-approved. Everyone in the Dim carries one.

The Half-Written.name: Draft Blade
The Half-Written.flavor_text: The edge is specified. The rest is not.

The Half-Written.name: Vestments of the Unspecified
The Half-Written.flavor_text: Cut for a body of no stated dimensions.

The Half-Written.name: Half-Written Girdle
The Half-Written.flavor_text: The buckle is described in detail. Nothing else is.

The Half-Written.name: Revision Loop
The Half-Written.flavor_text: Worn smooth in a way that suggests it has been made more than once.

Shardmaw.name: Shardmaw's Facet-Axe
Shardmaw.flavor_text: Grown, not forged, and better than forged.

Shardmaw.name: Druse-Plated Bulwark
Shardmaw.flavor_text: A sheet of the shell, still pointing inward.

Shardmaw.name: Maw-Scarred Pauldrons
Shardmaw.flavor_text: Chewed at, and the chew marks have themselves crystallised.

Shardmaw.name: Light-Swallower's Collar
Shardmaw.flavor_text: Holds no reflection at all, at any angle.

The Prism Warden.name: Warden's Refracting Crossbow
The Prism Warden.flavor_text: Fires one bolt. Three arrive, and two of them are not there.

The Prism Warden.name: Prismbound Hauberk
The Prism Warden.flavor_text: Shows a different colour to every person looking at it.

The Prism Warden.name: Total Reflection Bracers
The Prism Warden.flavor_text: Nothing gets out, which is a strange property for a bracer.

The Prism Warden.name: Warden's Splitting Lens
The Prism Warden.flavor_text: One lens. More than one image, and they disagree.

Heartgrown.name: Heartgrown Crushing Hammer
Heartgrown.flavor_text: The core of the geode grew a fist. This is the fist.

Heartgrown.name: Core-Grown Breastplate
Heartgrown.flavor_text: Still faintly growing, which the Codex say is fine.

Heartgrown.name: Cavity-Walker's Sabatons
Heartgrown.flavor_text: For standing in the only part of the Geode with any room left.

Heartgrown.name: The Last Open Space
Heartgrown.flavor_text: A hollow bead. It is the only hollow thing left in there.

The Index.name: Catalogue-Totem of the Stacks
The Index.flavor_text: A fruiting body grown in the shape of a thing it saw held.

The Index.name: Index-Grown Vestment
The Index.flavor_text: Ranked and ordered, like everything it makes.

The Index.name: Cross-Reference Bindings
The Index.flavor_text: Two straps, each referring to the other.

The Index.name: Entry Under Your Name
The Index.flavor_text: It has one. You have not told it anything.

The Second Copy.name: Duplicate Longbow
The Second Copy.flavor_text: An exact copy of a bow. Exact, except for the parts it guessed.

The Second Copy.name: Twice-Grown Scale Vest
The Second Copy.flavor_text: Every scale has a twin, and the twins are drifting apart.

The Second Copy.name: Copyist's Mail Coif
The Second Copy.flavor_text: Rings in ranks of forty. Then thirty-nine. Then forty.

The Second Copy.name: Repeated Error Band
The Second Copy.flavor_text: The flaw in it is reproduced perfectly.

The Scriptor.name: Scriptor's Nib-Gun
The Scriptor.flavor_text: Writes at range, in a hand nobody down here can read.

The Scriptor.name: Scrivener's Pressed Robes
The Scriptor.flavor_text: Flattened, smoothed, and ruled into columns.

The Scriptor.name: Fair Copy Handguards
The Scriptor.flavor_text: For work that must not be smudged.

The Scriptor.name: Struck-Through Girdle
The Scriptor.flavor_text: A single line drawn through it, end to end.

Errata.name: Thrown Correction
Errata.flavor_text: A wedge of hardened pulp. It is not the right shape for anything.

Errata.name: Mantle of Compounding Error
Errata.flavor_text: Grown from everything the Bloom got wrong and kept.

Errata.name: Uncorrected Legguards
Errata.flavor_text: One leg is longer. Nothing has been done about it.

Errata.name: Erratum Seal
Errata.flavor_text: Marks a mistake. Does not say which one.

The Deep Bloom.name: Greatblade of What It Learned
The Deep Bloom.flavor_text: It has never seen a sword. It has read about several.

The Deep Bloom.name: Heart-of-the-Network Harness
The Deep Bloom.flavor_text: Threads run out of it in every direction and do not end.

The Deep Bloom.name: Shroud of the Reading Thing
The Deep Bloom.flavor_text: Thin as paper, and it has your shape already.

The Deep Bloom.name: The Whole Network Answers
The Deep Bloom.flavor_text: Hold it and something very large pays attention.
